03 / STATISTICAL DECISION SUPPORT

Non-parametric test prediction & execution

Python · TF-IDF · Decision Trees · SciPy

CASE STUDYSource code ↗Research reference ↗
01 / THE QUESTION

The question

How can users choose an appropriate statistical test without navigating every methodological choice on their own?

02 / THE APPROACH

My contribution / approach

Contributed dataset curation, preprocessing, feature engineering, model experimentation, and methodology documentation. The framework uses NLP feature extraction and interpretable machine learning to recommend tests, including Runs, Wilcoxon Signed-Rank, and Mann–Whitney U.

03 / THE OUTPUT

The output

An end-to-end workflow that selects a test, executes it, and returns structured test statistics, p-values, and decision rules.

04 / CONTEXT

Context & limitations

Makes analytical workflows more accessible and consistent. Recommendations still depend on correctly specified data, assumptions, and study design.
